name: LaBeau's Hot Grilled Turkey & Avocado Sandwich on White Bread
whyItWorks: The safest savory item on the LaBeau's menu: lean sliced turkey breast and creamy avocado grilled on soft white bread—skipping deep-fryer oils entirely.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hot Turkey Avocado (or Turkey Club without tomato/lettuce) on grilled white bread.
watchOuts: Hold raw tomato and iceberg lettuce if flaring
